title: Load a benchmark preset and audit it end to end
description: A user can select a benchmark governance scenario, review the auto-populated proposal details, run the audit, and see the final verdict and decoded calldata results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a benign grant scenario
Verify the proposal fields are populated with scenario details
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify a final audit verdict and decoded calldata results are displayed

title: Submit a fully manual proposal for consensus analysis
description: A user can enter a proposal from scratch, submit it for multi-validator analysis, and see the audit pipeline progress through to a result.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in a proposal title
Fill in an intent description
Fill in the target contract field
Fill in the recipient field
Fill in the claimed amount field
Fill in valid hex calldata
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify the consensus pipeline progresses and a final audit result is displayed

title: Manually edit a loaded proposal before auditing
description: A user can change proposal details after loading a preset and then run the audit on the edited proposal.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a benign grant scenario
Modify the proposal title
Modify the intent description
Modify the target contract field
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify the audit begins processing for the edited proposal

title: Switch between presets without stale proposal data
description: A user can switch from one benchmark scenario to another and see every proposal input refresh to match the newly selected preset.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a benign grant scenario
Click a different benchmark preset for a stealth hijack scenario
Verify the proposal fields update to the newly selected scenario
Verify stale values from the previous preset are no longer shown

title: Detect a mismatch between intent and calldata
description: A user can submit a proposal whose intent does not match the calldata and see the app flag the discrepancy with a non-passed verdict.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a benign grant scenario
Modify the intent description to conflict with the loaded calldata
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify discrepancy indicators are displayed
Verify the final verdict is non-passed

title: See risk score and consensus stages complete in order
description: A user can run an audit and observe the risk score reach its final value while the consensus stages complete in sequence.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a stealth hijack scenario
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify the risk score gauge reaches a final value
Verify the consensus pipeline stages are completed

title: Review decoded calldata details after an audit
description: A user can complete an audit and inspect the decoded method, recipient, amount, and whitelist status derived from the submitted calldata.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for an unapproved target scenario
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify decoded calldata details are displayed
Verify recipient, amount, and whitelist status information are shown

title: Replace one benchmark scenario with another before auditing
description: A user can rapidly choose a new preset after a previous one and confirm the console refreshes the proposal context for the latest scenario before analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click a benchmark preset for a benign grant scenario
Click a benchmark preset for a trojan drain scenario
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify the audit reflects the most recently selected scenario

title: Handle invalid proposal input with a visible non-passed outcome
description: A user can enter malformed or conflicting proposal details and see the interface remain usable while showing a rejected or flagged audit outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in an invalid or malformed hex calldata value
Run the multi-validator consensus audit
Verify a validation or rejection message is displayed
Verify the audit result is not passed
